note: Both sets capture the deck assembly fasteners, panel, plywood, decking and plate dimensions faithfully. Set B correctly separates the 3/8" x 4" HEX THROUGH BOLT from the 3/8" X 4" HEX BOLT as two distinct fasteners, each supported by its own quote. Set A collapses these into a single 'hex bolt' claim whose quote is actually the through bolt, misbinding the label and dropping the separate hex bolt used at the railing post bracket.
remarks: The text layer lists both '3/8" x 4" HEX THROUGH BOLT' and '3/8" X 4" HEX BOLT' (the latter at the railing post bracket and in the A5 deck-to-house detail), so treating them as one component loses a real distinction. Both sets leave out the Clearvue cable railing, railing post bracket and adjustable scaffold footing, but those are largely labels rather than dimensional claims.
